filter: deleted_at IS NULL AND written_on >= 2026-07-01 AND source_url host csai.jbnu.ac.kr AND a single board
excluded: 1 article sighted on every board was left out of the 100
order: stratified by board with largest remainder, then shuffled with Random(42)
scoring_input_rule: cleanCrawledText(title) and cleanCrawledText(content)[:200], then tags.ts clean(), joined with ' \n '
gold_tags: 1 to 3 allowed tags separated by ';'. Use '일반' alone only when no other tag fits.
gold_primary: exactly one allowed tag, and it must appear in gold_tags
